notes: Five documents coded by both. Matched units were paired by passage; 112 of 113 B units matched an A unit. A coded finer (151 vs 113 units): 39 A-only units, of which 29 were kept (real clauses or list bullets B skipped, e.g. 3 of 6 AI-resilient strategy bullets, the Encouraged label, rationale clauses in the Khoury quotes) and 10 dropped (generic plagiarism/collaboration rules and a citation-help clause that name no AI, a page date, resource-list navigation, a repeat of the faculty-autonomy line, a clause already inside the AI-grading rule, a restated fundamentals-first sentence); the one B-only unit was kept. Main disagreements: (1) policy_type among neighbours, resolved by re-reading the sentence against the type definition: P42 vs P41/P55/P31 for fundamentals-first rationales, P95 vs P41 for the integrity rationale, P81 vs P69 for the OSCCR review sentence, P60 vs P35 for 'reconceive assignments rather than police' (P35 chosen, P60 means declining to police), P63 vs P70 for CATLR resources, P79 for the 'Stump Claude' activity; (2) modality: the source verb decided (should for 'should only enter Lock 1-3 data' although both coders said must; may for optional strategy bullets and for discretionary penalties; informs for example wording and contacts); (3) actor and phase for sample syllabus statements and assignment labels, resolved to the student the wording addresses and course-start/during-work as the wording indicates; (4) unit_stance, which A often coded encourage/require for communication duties and B neutral; communication and procedure units were set neutral. Document stance: 2 of 5 disagreed. OSCCR integrity policy A delegates vs B restrict, resolved to restrict because 'unauthorized use of ... artificial intelligence' is cheating by default; the Research Enterprise Services stub A delegates vs B permit, resolved to permit (a framework for fair use, hands nothing to instructors). Neither coder proposed new types; none recorded. All fit_note and uncovered_note text from either coder was kept or merged. Agreement shares are over the 112 matched units, computed on the coders' original codes before reconciliation.
